title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the doubles tennis match between Cervantes/Martinez and Liutarevich/Pieczonka in the Orleans, originally scheduled for November 14, 2026 at 12:30PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Cervantes/Martinez' if the team of Cervantes/Martinez advances against Liutarevich/Pieczonka.

This market will resolve to 'Liutarevich/Pieczonka' if the team of Liutarevich/Pieczonka advances against Cervantes/Martinez.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the team who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (a team withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
